anya: Quick flag — found a regression in the v3->v4 routing handshake when requests include both X-Client-Version and X-Compat-Opt. Some tenants hit a 502 from legacy sidecars.

matt: how reproducible?

anya: 100% on staging. Repro steps below. Saw two different failure modes: sidecar returns 502 with `invalid-envelope` and runtime returns upstream 502.

anya: ```
curl -i -H "X-Client-Version: 3.1" -H "X-Compat-Opt: passthru" \
  https://edge-internal.redwood/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}' -v
```

matt: hmm. looks like our header sniffing logic prefers X-Compat-Opt and rewrites into metadata.x-compat, but older sidecars still look for raw header.

sam: is this due to the header canonicalization change in ingress? we reordered parsing last week to normalize case and move opt headers under metadata.

anya: yep — ingress canonicalizes and moves compat header into an internal metadata map. newer runtimes read metadata.x-compat, sidecars expect raw header. mismatch -> sidecar chokes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling restart of edge-router v1.12 scheduled at 2024-09-12T21:00Z (canary 10%).

julia: short-term: make sidecar tolerant (accept metadata.x-compat) and add a small shim in edge-router to duplicate the header for raw consumers. long-term: formalize handshake normalization in the API contract (RFC).

matt: agreed. proposal: add a minimal shim in edge-router that, when feature flag `dup-compat-header` is on, injects `X-Compat-Opt` from metadata back into the raw header before proxying to sidecars. also emit telemetry `compat.header.dup.v1` with tenant id and sidecar accept metric.

anya: sounds good. owner? @matt + @julia?

matt: I can own the edge-router shim. I'll open an RFC + PR. rollout plan: feature flag default ON for 2w canary, then turn permanent after telemetry looks clean. PR will include unit + integration tests.

sam: also need comms: SRE + Dedicated accounts notified, console banner for tenants in staging/production that might be affected.

julia: I'll draft the advisory and add an internal console banner. sidecar repo: I'll add a small parser change to accept `metadata.x-compat` in addition to raw header (backwards-compatible). will include a short unit test.

anya: :thumbsup: thanks. please tag me when RFC PR is up so we can schedule the canary window.

matt: will do. planning notes: keep shim logic idempotent, avoid duplicating when header already exists, and set a 1-hour rate limit on telemetry emissions per tenant to avoid noise.

julia: also adding a tiny log rewrite for the 502 so we surface `sidecar:missing-raw-compat` to make postmortem easier.

anya: final: action items: matt -> RFC+PR for shim, julia -> sidecar parser + tests + advisory, sam -> comms with SRE and Dedicated. I'll run canary plan once PR is merged.

matt: opening RFC now.```
